lines.beaver_en: You look really tired lately. Are you okay?
lines.en: It seems I've had a lot of stress lately.

lines.beaver_en: What's going on? Too much work?
lines.learner: 네, 프로젝트 때문에 미칠 것 같아요.
lines.en: Yes, this project is driving me crazy.
lines.roman: ne, peurojekteu ttaemune michil geot gatayo.

lines.en: No, I seem to keep waking up at night.

lines.learner: 가끔 우울한 듯하고 아무것도 하기 싫어요.
lines.en: I feel kind of down sometimes and don't want to do anything.
lines.roman: gakkeum uulhan deutago amugeotdo hagi sireoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a way to relieve stress?
lines.learner: 운동을 해 봤는데 잘 안 풀려요.
lines.en: I tried exercising, but it doesn't really help.
lines.roman: undongeul hae bwanneunde jal an pullyeoyo.

lines.en: Not yet. Counseling seems a bit hard.

lines.beaver_en: Our company has a counseling program.
lines.en: Really? It's my first time, so I'm nervous.

lines.beaver: 저도 받아 봤는데 도움이 많이 됐어요.
lines.beaver_en: I tried it too, and it helped a lot.
lines.beaver_roman: jeodo bada bwanneunde doumi mani dwaesseoyo.
lines.en: I see. Talking might make me feel better.

lines.beaver_en: Be brave and sign up for it.
lines.en: Okay, I'll sign up for counseling today.

lines.beaver_en: Good call. Tell me anytime it gets hard.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 덕분에 스트레스가 좀 풀리는 듯해요.
lines.en: Thanks. Thanks to you, I feel a bit less stressed.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. deokbune seuteureseuga jom pullineun deutaeyo.
